inventory.system: Python AST blob record and deterministic query index
inventory.finding: ASTBlobRecord parses Python with ast.parse and deterministically records path-independent source/blob hashes, symbols, imports, calls, bounded line spans, and parse failures. AnalysisASTIndex binds those immutable records to safe repository-relative paths, invalidates changed/deleted evidence, and exposes bounded deterministic lookup. It is reusable derived evidence, not a datasets-owned CanonicalCodeIR or exact mutable-span linker.

The index projects ASTBlobRecord facts into a versioned source snapshot and parse cache, uses python-ast@schema-1 as its parser identifier, rejects parser drift/cache reuse, and gives unsupported languages and failed parses explicit frontiers. Its declared authority class is derived_evidence; it must not be reused as canonical semantic IR.

The index canonically serializes versioned vector configuration and rows, binds every query/hit to an exact snapshot, rejects bodies, incomplete/forged rows, dimensional mismatch, and stale configuration, and marks results semantic_authority=False. Similarity is therefore a recall hint only.

ArchitectureIR is a closed, version-1 graph of source-provenanced architecture facts. It derives and verifies dag-json CIDv1 content identities and rejects unknown fields, dangling edges, duplicate IDs, tree mismatch, and identity mismatch. Its scope is architecture planning, not the datasets-owned current-tree Python semantic IR required by PCSM.

inventory.system: Patch proposal, validation, and materialization controls
inventory.authority: ipfs_accelerate_py admits and materializes; Mcp-Plus-Plus owns the patch-proposal wire schema only
inventory.finding: The wire schema is closed and binds proposal/repository/patch identities with CIDv1 base32 validation while forbidding simulated provenance promotion. Accelerator validation parses Git-style unified diffs without a shell and has typed scope, syntax, stale-binding, identity, validation-plan, secret, and test-weakening rejection paths. CodeEditPacket and CodeEditMaterialize provide versioned task/report controls. These are the patch-system equivalents to reuse; no component was found that makes them a canonical Python CodeIR-to-exact-source relinker.

relevant_controls: ASTBlobRecord record_id is a deterministic SHA-256 over a canonical record payload and includes record_schema_version 1.
AnalysisASTIndex, DuckDBASTIndex, code-symbol-vector index, ArchitectureIR, CodeEditPacket, and CodeEditMaterialize expose versioned interfaces/schemas.
ArchitectureIR derives and verifies dag-json CIDv1 identities.
MCP++ PatchProposal@0.1 requires CIDv1 base32 proposal and repository-state identities and rejects pseudo-CIDs and simulated-to-live promotion.
The vector index binds rows, queries, and hits to an exact source snapshot/configuration and is expressly non-semantic authority.

minimum_versioned_delta.reason: No inspected current-head equivalent simultaneously provides a datasets-owned Python CanonicalCodeIR with exact current-tree node/span identity, canonical semantic CID lineage, alias-to-canonical relinking, and deterministic M1 rewrite admission. This inventory only selects reusable components; implementing that delta here would exceed the receipt-only output and create or relocate authority.
